scope: Replacement of the unreachable showcase-image hero with a resilient creation entry point, including copy hierarchy, create/explore destinations, responsive behavior, motion boundaries, and public-information review.
decisions: Replaced the image-dependent showcase with a text-first promise and two native paths: Start creating -> /images and Explore creations -> /explore.
Added a static Image Studio preview that explains Describe, Make, and Discover without fake editor controls, remote artwork, or simulated generation progress.
Removed hero-only galaxy image, canvas, parallax, shooting-star, and control machinery; retained the lower-page story geometry and sticky pause control for the sections that still use motion.
Stacked the hero and creation-flow preview below 760px, with a vertical flow list and wrapped actions so copy and touch targets remain readable at narrow widths.

quality_checks.lint: npm run lint passed with zero errors and eight pre-existing warnings outside the changed hero files
quality_checks.production_build: npm run build passed and generated 163 static pages
quality_checks.production_html: Local production smoke test returned 200; the new heading, supporting copy, Image Studio preview and no-setup note were present; stale showcase labels and /images/showcase asset paths were absent from the root hero output
quality_checks.responsive: Source review confirmed a two-column desktop hero, single-column layout at 760px, and a vertical creation-flow list on narrow screens; no fixed-width hero asset remains
quality_checks.accessibility: Native links retain visible focus styles and 48px minimum action heights; the creation flow exposes list semantics and the hero keeps one level-one heading
quality_checks.public_boundary: Hero copy describes customer capabilities only and does not expose provider, topology, credential, routing, or operational diagnostics
quality_checks.detector: Targeted impeccable detector completed; remaining findings are advisory design-system color/font/radius values in the existing homepage stylesheet, with no blocking layout or structure finding acted on in this pass

limits: No live deployment or hosted-site acceptance is implied.
Browser screenshot capture was unavailable in this environment; production HTML, TypeScript, lint, build, and source-level responsive checks were used instead.
The legacy scripts/verify-homepage-ui.mjs fixture still contains historical Sites and galaxy assertions and was not treated as an acceptance gate for this replacement.
